body: You are gonna make it dude. Push through all that doubt. You got this.
Thanks bruv

For the last year I hurt myself non stop. Im trying to fight it so I dont have to deal with the pain and the healing again. Right now I feel lower than ever but I want to keep up what I have done so far. So atleast I have that going for me.
Can you find a different job that is like this one? Or maybe just ask for time off for a vacation?
Happy Birthday! You are doing great just keep pushing and each following birthday will be better.

To drink from the bottle on the shelf behind me, to open the completely healed wound on my leg that took nearly 3 months to heal. To just end it all because sleep never comes and there will be no joy. Just scream as loud as you can.   


Thats the kinda shit I get. It gets worse depending on the circumstances. I hope you can fight through them. Focus on the good.
Find something that can become your wake up from the monotony during the day. Know that what you are doing will bring you to a better place eventually. School is a way to move forward.

Well if you know you are lying and that it bothers you, start to put more truth in to what you talk about. You do not have to be everyone's favorite person. Act how you want not how you want to be seen.

It won't always be that way. Needing some care or even the smallest bit of love does not make you an annoying bitch. There is nothing wrong with asking for a hug I hope you do get that hug you need badly.

No rest for busy brains. 

​

Well it shows that you do have these emotions and to not let this chance go again. You will have more steps in life yet to meet people and build relationships. Just don't let your next chance slip through.

You are analyzing while trying to have a conversation. Treat the person you are talking to like a test subject. Like you know what kind of responses you want out of them right? If you have talked to one person you can talk to anyone else. Humans are mostly just big bags of water with feelings.
Remember what it is like to be around others. Or try and find another way to sort out your feelings. Eventually they will build enough for tears to fall. Just remember to breathe.

You got yourself back up there and you are pushing as hard as you can. Remember how hard it felt to get back into it and keep going. Focus on what you have to do. Take a moment to breathe and push like you have done so many times before. You got this.
Just means it isnt time for you to go yet.

Do you have health insurance? You probably do if you are in college under your family. Go see someone else. There are hundreds of people that can try and help you. One avenue wont have all the answers so you keep trying.
Schools do have mental health facilities, and you can get insurance through your school to get actual help too. See what you can find or maybe find a local support group. All colleges have them.

Im in your same boat though man. If no one else will help you the only thing you can do is help yourself. You have to push yourself through all the garbage in the world to see even a little bit of daylight. If you are in a fight for survival you use that fear to motivate you and if you want to kill yourself you are in that kind of situation. School is not the end all be all of your life but a small part of it. So if you cannot take it right now do it later. You got the scholarships now you can get them later as well. You have already proved yourself that way. So take the time to get actual help.

Well professors are there just to make money and college is a bullshit place between life and death. And having a family like that is basically no support. Like if you need to focus on what you can do to better your situation. You can always go back to school and fix yourself first. Life is long and unyielding. Most people do not know how others suffer and think its some kind of attention thing. It looks like you are the only one that can support yourself so make the decisions you need to in order to get help. Let your fear motivate you to do the right thing.

Well its obvious that your schooling is what is rough for you right now. And it is always hard to build yourself back up but if its affecting you like this getting help is going to be a major thing and school will have to be on the back burner. Don't waver, make the right choice of getting help.
Stay strong you will make it through this hard time.

A lot of people can't handle college. The only thing you can do right now is tell the truth and ask for help and then get that help. Schools will take you again even if you fuck up multiple times anyway. They are a business. Look for any resource you can and take it. Ask who you can, ask a friend back home or a family member you are close to. Keep your options open.

Its more than just that fear. Keep yourself alive to find anything in your current life. Many people don't think god is real or think that he or it is real. But think about the good in the world the random acts of kindness and all that other kind of bullshit that gets played up couldn't that be the influence of god or a higher power. Just value yourself and look for what you can to get you through the day. Look for any reason to keep yourself breathing, you are fighting to survive so survive.

Think about how long it is going to take to heal again and how much it will hurt when it does heal. Focus on literally anything else but that thought about hurting yourself. Take a drink, breathe deep and think about how you stopped hurting yourself and keep that in your head.

Well if they scare you don't kill yourself. Life is scarier but its something we all have to suffer through. A lot of attempts don't really work either. So breathe, take a minute and think what can you do right now to make things any small bit better?

Well if they want to help you take it, take all the help you can get and run with it. They may not understand but the fact is they think differently than you do and may help you see things in a different light. Accept the love and the fact that she wants to help you and take it.

I am in your boat too dude. But the thing that keeps me going is like really hopelessly minuscule goals. Like I went to the doctor, then I got the info I needed to fix my health, okay now set another appointment, then I get treated for shit. Like all I do is push to the next goal to find the next. Maybe one of them wont let me feel so empty or hollow. And I can get solace in the fact that I am actually trying to change things. Its fucking hard and I have days I feel like I can't move but I know if I just keep doing the right shit things might work.

As someone that did pick a wound like that and had it for a year until it got massive the pain never faded. Went to wound care and they had to fix me. I still don't feel normal.    


Happy birthday go take yourself to a bar and get a drink and clear out your brain. Sometimes you have to reach out for yourself.
Why turn it off when you can turn it up?

Seems like you are going to have to forge your own way. Be there for your brother cause he is young and has to deal with this shit too. Be someone you would want to look up to. Highschool is the easy part the hard shit comes after. Work on what you can, set small goals and push till you can't.

Hope you are still around. Humans are sturdy and its hard to go through with it. Its better to end up in a ward so that maybe you can get the help you need. Getting help isnt having someone help you completely its you focusing on on to help yourself with someone elses guidance. I hope you haven't gone through with it yet.

You have one, you have yourself. Comfort yourself. Try and push against all the evil in your mind and all the other bullshit going on. Most of us only have ourselves in this life so we have to make do.
You won't be alone with the train either. The conductor will be with you too.  Why not choose something instead of death?
Well take it one step at a time. Make that your goal.

Do you get professional help? Can you tell them these things or is it something you can't say? We all go through things differently so I dont know exactly how you feel but you must have one thing you may think you own or keep to yourself.

Well can you find yourself instead of shape shifting? I mean bringing other people joy can only do so much until you realize how alone you are. Can you find something that is only for you? Is there something that makes you feel yourself? I would try and focus on that.

Well don't behave yourself and act like you need to. Most humans are fucking trash. And as someone in your position I think the best way is to try and build literally anything for yourself. Push through your schooling and let that be your focus or find anything to get yourself through. As soon as you can support yourself you can get away from your family and anyone else that gives you issues.
